fix_subject: Fix a crash that could occur if sqlite3_deserialize() was used to overwrite a database with an open transaction on it. Bug introduced by [fc42d31d6fca21ab] on 2018-03-07 and first released in version 3.23.0. This is not a vulnerability as an attacker that can exploit this already has the ability to execute arbitrary code. Forum post [forum:39134ba029 | 39134ba029].
